---
title: "Staggered Difference-in-Differences (Callaway & Sant'Anna)"
author: "Manos Giannitselis"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(did)      # Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) estimator
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r example-data, echo=FALSE}
# Small simulated stand-in for the real county-year panel, so this file
# runs standalone. See treatment-definition/ and pca-explained/ for how
# `g` (first treated year) and PC1-PC4 are actually constructed.
set.seed(42)
n_counties <- 60
years <- 2015:2023

county_first_treat <- tibble(
  county_id = 1:n_counties,
  g = sample(c(0, 2018:2021), n_counties, replace = TRUE,
             prob = c(0.25, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.15))  # g = 0 means never treated
)

df <- expand.grid(county_id = 1:n_counties, year = years) %>%
  left_join(county_first_treat, by = "county_id") %>%
  mutate(
    region_name = factor(rep(c("North", "South", "East", "West"), length.out = n())),
    PC1 = rnorm(n()), PC2 = rnorm(n()), PC3 = rnorm(n()), PC4 = rnorm(n()),
    treated_now = as.integer(g != 0 & year >= g),
    est = 100 + 2 * (year - min(years)) +
      treated_now * 5 +                     # true treatment effect
      county_id * 0.1 + rnorm(n(), 0, 3)     # county-level noise
  )
```

## Estimating group-time ATTs

```{r att-gt}
did_est <- att_gt(
  yname         = "est",              # outcome: number of establishments
  tname         = "year",
  idname        = "county_id",
  gname         = "g",                 # first-treated year (0 = never treated)
  xformla       = ~ PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4 + region_name,
  data          = df,
  control_group = "notyettreated",
  est_method    = "dr",                # doubly robust
  bstrap        = TRUE,
  biters        = 200,
  cband         = TRUE
)

summary(did_est)
```

## Aggregating to a single overall effect

```{r aggregate-simple}
agg_est <- aggte(did_est, type = "simple", na.rm = TRUE)
summary(agg_est)
```

## Event-study (dynamic) aggregation

```{r aggregate-dynamic}
es_est <- aggte(did_est, type = "dynamic", na.rm = TRUE)

df_es <- tibble(
  event_time = es_est$egt,
  att        = es_est$att.egt,
  se         = es_est$se.egt
) %>%
  mutate(
    ci_low  = att - 1.96 * se,
    ci_high = att + 1.96 * se
  )

df_es
```

```{r event-study-plot}
ggplot(df_es, aes(x = event_time, y = att)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray40") +
  labs(
    title = "Event Study: Effect of Yelp Review Surge on Establishments",
    x = "Years Since Treatment",
    y = "ATT"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Pre-trends check

```{r pre-trends}
# Pre-treatment event-time estimates (t < 0) should be statistically
# indistinguishable from zero if parallel trends holds.
df_es %>% filter(event_time < 0)
```
